internal.title: Kafka Consumer Lag Incident in Accounting Service - Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:16 UTC, an alert for high Kafka consumer lag was triggered for the accounting service, indicating a backlog of 5200 records. The diagnosis confirmed a queue backlog issue in the accounting Kafka consumer. To mitigate the issue, the ops team disabled the kafkaQueueProblems flag at 11:36 UTC, which led to recovery and normalization of the consumer lag metric. The incident was resolved shortly after the mitigation action was executed and verified.

Timeline:
- 11:16:26: Alert received for high Kafka consumer lag.
- 11:36:11: Diagnosis confirmed accounting queue backlog.
- 11:36:18: Disabled kafkaQueueProblems flag.
- 11:36:18: Recovery verified with consumer lag reduced to normal levels.

No errors or latency issues were detected in the accounting service, confirming the root cause was the Kafka consumer backlog.
